newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: INTERVIEW-Independent seeks acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Independent seeks acquisitions.

text.p: Ireland's Independent Newspapers Plc said on Wednesday that it remains on the lookout for acquisitions and has plenty scope to fund expansion following a recent rights issue.
"We continue all the time to look around," chief executive Liam Healy told Reuters. "We would look primarily in those areas where we are operating, any other suitable opportunity that came up."
The group has media and advertising operations in Ireland, Britain, France, South Africa, Australia and New Zealand.
